relationships.subject: elemene
relationships.evidence_quote: we found that the treatment of the chemotherapy drug elemene induced hyperalgesia accompanied by anxiety-like emotions in mice based on several pain behavioral assays, such as mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia tests

relationships.subject: elemene
relationships.evidence_quote: immunostaining for c-fos (a marker of activated neurons) further showed that elemene treatment activated several brain regions, including the lateral septum (LS), cingulate cortex (ACC), paraventricular nucleus of the thalamus (PVT), and dorsomedial hypothalamic nucleus (DMH), most notably in the GABAergic neurons of the lateral septum (LS)

relationships.subject: lateral septum GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: we found that both chemogenetic inhibition and apoptosis of LS neurons significantly reduced pain- and anxiety-like behaviors in mice treated with elemene

key_findings: The chemotherapeutic elemene induces mechanical allodynia, thermal hyperalgesia and anxiety-like behavior in mice and activates lateral septum GABAergic neurons.
Chemogenetic inhibition or apoptosis of lateral septum neurons reduces elemene-induced pain and anxiety-like behaviors, identifying LS as a therapeutic target.
